# CSSzyx — Full API Reference

> Object-syntax Tailwind CSS. Type-safe. Zero runtime. SSR-safe.
> For the lite version: https://csszyx.com/llms.txt

This file contains the complete sz prop mapping for all categories.
Source of truth: docs/specs/snippets/ in the CSSzyx repository.
Last updated: 2026-03-05 (Tailwind v4.2 compatible)

---

## OVERVIEW

CSSzyx transforms JSX `sz` props into Tailwind v4 utility classes at build time.

```tsx
// Input (your code)
<div sz={{ p: 4, bg: 'blue-500', hover: { bg: 'blue-700' } }} />

// Build-time output
<div className="p-4 bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700" />

// Production output (with mangle: true)
<div class="z y x" />   // CSS: .z{padding:1rem} .y{background-color:...} .x{...}
```

### Install

```bash
npm install csszyx
```

### Vite setup

```js
import csszyx from 'csszyx/vite';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [...csszyx(), tailwindcss()],  // csszyx MUST be first
});
```

### Key rules

- Numbers are bare for any integer or 0.5-step decimal: `{ p: 4 }` → `p-4`, `{ p: 1.5 }` → `p-1.5`
- Arbitrary CSS values auto-wrap in `[]`: `{ p: '5px' }` → `p-[5px]`
- CSS variables auto-wrap in `()`: `{ p: '--my-var' }` → `p-(--my-var)`
- Variants are nested objects: `{ hover: { bg: 'blue' } }` → `hover:bg-blue`
- Boolean sugar: `{ flex: true }` → `flex`, `{ hidden: true }` → `hidden`
- Color opacity: `{ bg: { color: 'blue-500', op: 50 } }` → `bg-blue-500/50`

---

## CORE CONCEPTS

### Basic Utilities

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Padding | `p-6` | `{ p: 6 }` |
| Background Color | `bg-sky-500` | `{ bg: 'sky-500' }` |
| Text Color | `text-white` | `{ color: 'white' }` |
| Border Radius | `rounded-lg` | `{ rounded: 'lg' }` |
| Box Shadow | `shadow-xl` | `{ shadow: 'xl' }` |
| Flex Container | `flex` | `{ flex: true }` |

### State Modifiers

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Hover | `hover:bg-sky-700` | `{ hover: { bg: 'sky-700' } }` |
| Focus | `focus:outline-none` | `{ focus: { outline: 'none' } }` |
| Active | `active:opacity-80` | `{ active: { opacity: 80 } }` |
| Disabled+Hover | `disabled:hover:bg-sky-500` | `{ disabled: { hover: { bg: 'sky-500' } } }` |

### Responsive Breakpoints

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Small | `sm:grid-cols-3` | `{ sm: { gridCols: 3 } }` |
| Medium | `md:flex` | `{ md: { flex: true } }` |
| Large | `lg:px-8` | `{ lg: { px: 8 } }` |
| Breakpoint range | `md:max-xl:flex` | `{ md: { maxXl: { flex: true } } }` |
| Custom | `min-[320px]:text-center` | `{ min: { '[320px]': { textAlign: 'center' } } }` |

### Dark Mode

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Dark background | `dark:bg-gray-800` | `{ dark: { bg: 'gray-800' } }` |
| Dark text | `dark:text-white` | `{ dark: { color: 'white' } }` |

### Arbitrary Values

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop | Note |
|---------|-------------------|---------|------|
| Arbitrary color | `bg-[#316ff6]` | `{ bg: '#316ff6' }` | |
| Arbitrary size | `w-[333px]` | `{ w: '333px' }` | |
| CSS variable | `w-(--spacing-4)` | `{ w: '--spacing-4' }` | Auto-detects `--` prefix |

### Complex Selectors

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Group Hover | `group-hover:text-blue` | `{ group: { hover: { color: 'blue' } } }` |
| Peer Focus | `peer-focus:text-blue` | `{ peer: { focus: { color: 'blue' } } }` |
| Data Attribute | `data-[active]:text-blue` | `{ data: { active: { color: 'blue' } } }` |
| ARIA Attribute | `aria-expanded:text-blue` | `{ aria: { expanded: { color: 'blue' } } }` |
| Arbitrary Variant | `[&>span]:text-blue` | `{ '[& > span]': { color: 'blue' } }` |
| Important | `text-red-500!` | `{ color: 'red-500!' }` |
| Named Group | `group-hover/name:text-white` | `{ group: { name: { hover: { color: 'white' } } } }` |

### Pseudo-classes

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| First/Last child | `first:pt-0 last:pb-0` | `{ first: { pt: 0 }, last: { pb: 0 } }` |
| Odd/Even | `odd:bg-white even:bg-gray` | `{ odd: { bg: 'white' }, even: { bg: 'gray' } }` |
| Focus Within | `focus-within:ring` | `{ focusWithin: { ring: true } }` |
| Focus Visible | `focus-visible:ring` | `{ focusVisible: { ring: true } }` |
| Has | `has-[img]:bg-blue` | `{ has: { img: { bg: 'blue' } } }` |
| Not | `not-hover:opacity-75` | `{ not: { hover: { opacity: 75 } } }` |
| Target | `target:shadow` | `{ target: { shadow: true } }` |
| Visited | `visited:text-purple` | `{ visited: { color: 'purple' } }` |

### Pseudo-elements

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Before/After | `before:content-['']` | `{ before: { ... } }` |
| Placeholder | `placeholder:text-gray` | `{ placeholder: { color: 'gray' } }` |
| File | `file:border` | `{ file: { border: true } }` |
| Selection | `selection:bg-pink` | `{ selection: { bg: 'pink' } }` |
| First Line | `first-line:uppercase` | `{ firstLine: { uppercase: true } }` |
| First Letter | `first-letter:text-7xl` | `{ firstLetter: { text: '7xl' } }` |

### Media & Feature Queries

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Reduced Motion | `motion-reduce:hidden` | `{ motionReduce: { hidden: true } }` |
| Print | `print:hidden` | `{ print: { hidden: true } }` |
| Portrait | `portrait:hidden` | `{ portrait: { hidden: true } }` |
| Supports | `supports-[display:grid]:grid` | `{ supports: { 'display:grid': { grid: true } } }` |
| Starting Style | `starting:opacity-0` | `{ starting: { opacity: 0 } }` |

### Container Queries

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Mark Container | `@container` | `{ '@container': true }` |
| Named Container | `@container/sidebar` | `{ '@container': 'sidebar' }` |
| Container Breakpoint | `@md:flex` | `{ '@md': { flex: true } }` |
| Named Query | `@md/sidebar:block` | `{ '@md': { sidebar: { block: true } } }` |
| Arbitrary Query | `@min-[475px]:flex` | `{ '@min': { '[475px]': { flex: true } } }` |

### Colors with Opacity

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Standard | `bg-blue-500` | `{ bg: 'blue-500' }` |
| Integer opacity | `bg-blue-500/50` | `{ bg: { color: 'blue-500', op: 50 } }` |
| Decimal opacity | `bg-black/75.5` | `{ bg: { color: 'black', op: 75.5 } }` |
| Arbitrary opacity | `bg-pink-500/[78%]` | `{ bg: { color: 'pink-500', op: '78%' } }` |
| CSS var opacity | `bg-blue-500/(--alpha)` | `{ bg: { color: 'blue-500', op: '--alpha' } }` |

### Attribute Selectors

| Concept | Tailwind v4 Class | sz Prop |
|---------|-------------------|---------|
| Data | `data-[active]:bg-blue` | `{ data: { active: { bg: 'blue' } } }` |
| ARIA | `aria-checked:bg-blue` | `{ aria: { checked: { bg: 'blue' } } }` |
| RTL | `rtl:mr-2` | `{ rtl: { mr: 2 } }` |
| Open | `open:bg-white` | `{ open: { bg: 'white' } }` |
| Direct children | `*:p-4` | `{ '*': { p: 4 } }` |

---

## SPACING

### Padding

All accept: any integer, 0.5-step decimal, `'px'`, `'auto'`, arbitrary string, CSS variable.

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | CSS Property |
|---------|----------------|--------------|
| `{ p: N }` | `p-N` | padding (all sides) |
| `{ px: N }` | `px-N` | padding-inline |
| `{ py: N }` | `py-N` | padding-block |
| `{ pt: N }` | `pt-N` | padding-top |
| `{ pr: N }` | `pr-N` | padding-right |
| `{ pb: N }` | `pb-N` | padding-bottom |
| `{ pl: N }` | `pl-N` | padding-left |
| `{ ps: N }` | `ps-N` | padding-inline-start (logical) |
| `{ pe: N }` | `pe-N` | padding-inline-end (logical) |
| `{ pbs: N }` | `pbs-N` | padding-block-start (v4.2) |
| `{ pbe: N }` | `pbe-N` | padding-block-end (v4.2) |
| `{ p: '5px' }` | `p-[5px]` | padding: 5px |
| `{ p: '--p' }` | `p-(--p)` | padding: var(--p) |

### Margin

All accept: any integer (including negative), 0.5-step decimal, `'px'`, `'auto'`, arbitrary, CSS variable.

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | Note |
|---------|----------------|------|
| `{ m: N }` | `m-N` | margin (all sides) |
| `{ m: -N }` | `-m-N` | negative margin |
| `{ mx: N }` | `mx-N` | margin-inline |
| `{ my: N }` | `my-N` | margin-block |
| `{ mt: N }` | `mt-N` | margin-top |
| `{ mr: N }` | `mr-N` | margin-right |
| `{ mb: N }` | `mb-N` | margin-bottom |
| `{ ml: N }` | `ml-N` | margin-left |
| `{ ms: N }` | `ms-N` | margin-inline-start |
| `{ me: N }` | `me-N` | margin-inline-end |
| `{ mbs: N }` | `mbs-N` | margin-block-start (v4.2) |
| `{ mbe: N }` | `mbe-N` | margin-block-end (v4.2) |
| `{ m: 'auto' }` | `m-auto` | |

### Space Between

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ spaceX: N }` | `space-x-N` |
| `{ spaceY: N }` | `space-y-N` |
| `{ spaceXReverse: true }` | `space-x-reverse` |
| `{ spaceYReverse: true }` | `space-y-reverse` |
| `{ spaceX: -N }` | `-space-x-N` |

## SIZING

### Width

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | Note |
|---------|----------------|------|
| `{ w: N }` | `w-N` | any integer or 0.5-step decimal |
| `{ w: 'full' }` | `w-full` | 100% |
| `{ w: 'screen' }` | `w-screen` | 100vw |
| `{ w: 'svw' }` | `w-svw` | 100svw |
| `{ w: 'min' }` | `w-min` | min-content |
| `{ w: 'max' }` | `w-max` | max-content |
| `{ w: 'fit' }` | `w-fit` | fit-content |
| `{ w: 'auto' }` | `w-auto` | |
| `{ w: '1/2' }` | `w-1/2` | fraction |
| `{ minW: N }` | `min-w-N` | min-width |
| `{ maxW: N }` | `max-w-N` | max-width |
| `{ maxW: '2xl' }` | `max-w-2xl` | 42rem |
| `{ maxW: 'prose' }` | `max-w-prose` | 65ch |

### Height

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ h: N }` | `h-N` |
| `{ h: 'full' }` | `h-full` |
| `{ h: 'screen' }` | `h-screen` |
| `{ h: 'svh' }` | `h-svh` |
| `{ h: 'dvh' }` | `h-dvh` |
| `{ minH: N }` | `min-h-N` |
| `{ maxH: N }` | `max-h-N` |

### Combined Size

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | Note |
|---------|----------------|------|
| `{ size: N }` | `size-N` | sets both width and height |
| `{ size: 'full' }` | `size-full` | |
| `{ blockSize: N }` | `block-N` | logical height (v4.2) |
| `{ inlineSize: N }` | `inline-N` | logical width (v4.2) |
| `{ minBlockSize: N }` | `min-block-N` | v4.2 |
| `{ maxBlockSize: N }` | `max-block-N` | v4.2 |
| `{ minInlineSize: N }` | `min-inline-N` | v4.2 |
| `{ maxInlineSize: N }` | `max-inline-N` | v4.2 |
| `{ container: true }` | `container` | responsive max-width |

## LAYOUT

### Display

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ block: true }` | `block` |
| `{ inline: true }` | `inline` |
| `{ inlineBlock: true }` | `inline-block` |
| `{ flex: true }` | `flex` |
| `{ inlineFlex: true }` | `inline-flex` |
| `{ grid: true }` | `grid` |
| `{ inlineGrid: true }` | `inline-grid` |
| `{ contents: true }` | `contents` |
| `{ table: true }` | `table` |
| `{ hidden: true }` | `hidden` |
| `{ srOnly: true }` | `sr-only` |
| `{ notSrOnly: true }` | `not-sr-only` |
| `{ flowRoot: true }` | `flow-root` |
| `{ listItem: true }` | `list-item` |
| `{ display: 'block' }` | `block` | canonical form |

### Position

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ static: true }` | `static` |
| `{ fixed: true }` | `fixed` |
| `{ absolute: true }` | `absolute` |
| `{ relative: true }` | `relative` |
| `{ sticky: true }` | `sticky` |

### Placement (top/right/bottom/left)

All accept: integer, negative integer, fraction string, `'px'`, `'full'`, `'auto'`, arbitrary, CSS var.

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | Note |
|---------|----------------|------|
| `{ inset: N }` | `inset-N` | all sides |
| `{ insetX: N }` | `inset-x-N` | inline |
| `{ insetY: N }` | `inset-y-N` | block |
| `{ top: N }` | `top-N` | |
| `{ right: N }` | `right-N` | |
| `{ bottom: N }` | `bottom-N` | |
| `{ left: N }` | `left-N` | |
| `{ start: N }` | `inset-s-N` | logical inline-start (v4.2) |
| `{ end: N }` | `inset-e-N` | logical inline-end (v4.2) |
| `{ insetS: N }` | `inset-s-N` | alias for start (v4.2) |
| `{ insetE: N }` | `inset-e-N` | alias for end (v4.2) |
| `{ insetBs: N }` | `inset-bs-N` | block-start (v4.2) |
| `{ insetBe: N }` | `inset-be-N` | block-end (v4.2) |

### Overflow

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ overflow: 'hidden' }` | `overflow-hidden` |
| `{ overflow: 'auto' }` | `overflow-auto` |
| `{ overflow: 'scroll' }` | `overflow-scroll` |
| `{ overflow: 'clip' }` | `overflow-clip` |
| `{ overflowX: 'hidden' }` | `overflow-x-hidden` |
| `{ overflowY: 'auto' }` | `overflow-y-auto` |
| `{ overscroll: 'contain' }` | `overscroll-contain` |

### Z-Index

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ z: N }` | `z-N` |
| `{ z: -N }` | `-z-N` |
| `{ z: 'auto' }` | `z-auto` |

### Visibility

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ visible: true }` | `visible` |
| `{ invisible: true }` | `invisible` |
| `{ collapse: true }` | `collapse` |

### Aspect Ratio

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ aspect: 'square' }` | `aspect-square` |
| `{ aspect: 'video' }` | `aspect-video` |
| `{ aspect: '4/3' }` | `aspect-4/3` |

### Float / Clear

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ float: 'right' }` | `float-right` |
| `{ float: 'left' }` | `float-left` |
| `{ clear: 'both' }` | `clear-both` |

### Object Fit / Position

|---------|----------------|
| `{ objectFit: 'cover' }` | `object-cover` |
| `{ objectFit: 'contain' }` | `object-contain` |
| `{ objectPos: 'center' }` | `object-center` |

## TYPOGRAPHY

### Font Family

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ fontFamily: 'sans' }` | `font-sans` |
| `{ fontFamily: 'serif' }` | `font-serif` |
| `{ fontFamily: 'mono' }` | `font-mono` |
| `{ fontFamily: "'My Font'" }` | `font-['My_Font']` |
| `{ fontFamily: '--f' }` | `font-(family-name:--f)` |

### Font Size

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class | Note |
|---------|----------------|------|
| `{ text: 'xs' }` | `text-xs` | Sets size + line-height |
| `{ text: 'sm' }` | `text-sm` | |
| `{ text: 'base' }` | `text-base` | |
| `{ text: 'lg' }` | `text-lg` | |
| `{ text: 'xl' }` | `text-xl` | |
| `{ text: '2xl' }` | `text-2xl` | |
| `{ text: '3xl' }` | `text-3xl` | |
| `{ text: '4xl' }` | `text-4xl` | |
| `{ text: '5xl' }` | `text-5xl` | |
| `{ text: '6xl' }` | `text-6xl` | |
| `{ text: '7xl' }` | `text-7xl` | |
| `{ text: '8xl' }` | `text-8xl` | |
| `{ text: '9xl' }` | `text-9xl` | |
| `{ text: '16px' }` | `text-[16px]` | |

### Line Height

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ leading: 'none' }` | `leading-none` |
| `{ leading: 'tight' }` | `leading-tight` |
| `{ leading: 'normal' }` | `leading-normal` |
| `{ leading: 'relaxed' }` | `leading-relaxed` |
| `{ leading: 'loose' }` | `leading-loose` |
| `{ leading: N }` | `leading-N` |

**Text+Leading shorthand:** `{ text: 'lg', leading: 7 }` → `text-lg/7`

### Text Alignment

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |
|---------|----------------|
| `{ textAlign: 'left' }` | `text-left` |
| `{ textAlign: 'center' }` | `text-center` |
| `{ textAlign: 'right' }` | `text-right` |
| `{ textAlign: 'justify' }` | `text-justify` |

### Text Color

| sz Prop | Tailwind Class |

## RUNTIME API

```ts
import { _sz, _szIf, _szSwitch, _szMerge, __szColorVar } from '@csszyx/runtime';
```

### `_sz(...classes: string[]): string`

Concatenates class strings, filtering falsy values.

```tsx
<div className={_sz('base', isActive && 'active')} />
```

### `_szIf(condition, trueClass, falseClass?): string`

Returns one of two class strings based on condition.

```tsx
<div className={_szIf(isError, 'border-red-500', 'border-gray-200')} />
```

### `_szSwitch(value, map): string`

Returns class string based on enum value.

```tsx
<div className={_szSwitch(status, {
  loading: 'opacity-50',
  error: 'border-red-500',
  success: 'border-green-500',
})} />
```

### `_szMerge(...classes: string[]): string`

Merges class strings (last value wins for conflicts, uses tailwind-merge semantics).

```tsx
<div className={_szMerge(baseClasses, overrideClasses)} />
```

### `__szColorVar(varName: string): string`

Wraps a CSS variable as an RGB color value.

```tsx
const color = __szColorVar('--ds-primary'); // → 'rgb(var(--ds-primary))'
```

---

## SSR HYDRATION

CSSzyx uses SHA-256 checksums to validate that the server-rendered mangle map matches the client's. If they differ, the runtime aborts hydration to prevent invisible CSS.

### Server setup (Next.js)

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { initRuntime } from '@csszyx/runtime';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';

export default async function RootLayout({ children }) {
  const hdrs = await headers();
  initRuntime({ checksum: hdrs.get('x-csszyx-checksum') ?? '' });
  return <html>{children}</html>;
}
```

### Recovery tokens

On checksum mismatch, a recovery token is injected into the HTML. The browser can detect this and reload with the correct styles.

---

## PLUGIN CONFIG

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import csszyx from 'csszyx/vite';

csszyx({
  // Production mangling
  production: {
    mangle: true,       // Mangle class names (p-4 → z)
    minify: true,       // Minify generated CSS (default: true with mangle)
  },
  // Prefix for all generated classes (matches Tailwind prefix config)
  prefix: 'tw-',
})
```

### Plugin order requirement

```js
plugins: [
  ...csszyx(),     // MUST come before tailwindcss
  tailwindcss(),
]
```

---

## TAILWIND v4.2 NEW PROPS

Added in Tailwind CSS v4.2, available in CSSzyx:

- `pbs`, `pbe` — padding-block-start/end
- `mbs`, `mbe` — margin-block-start/end (supports negative)
- `blockSize`, `minBlockSize`, `maxBlockSize` — logical height
- `inlineSize`, `minInlineSize`, `maxInlineSize` — logical width
- `start`, `end`, `insetS`, `insetE` — emits `inset-s-*`/`inset-e-*`
- `insetBs`, `insetBe` — inset-block-start/end
- `borderBs`, `borderBe` — border-block-start/end width
- `scrollPbs`, `scrollPbe` — scroll-padding-block-start/end
- `scrollMbs`, `scrollMbe` — scroll-margin-block-start/end
- `fontFeatures` — font-feature-settings

---

## COMMON MISTAKES

### Wrong: slash notation for opacity
```tsx
// ❌ Not supported
{ bg: 'blue-500/50' }

// ✅ Correct
{ bg: { color: 'blue-500', op: 50 } }
```

### Wrong: brackets in sz values
```tsx
// ❌ Don't add brackets
{ p: '[5px]' }

// ✅ Correct — compiler auto-wraps
{ p: '5px' }
```

### Wrong: plugin order
```js
// ❌ Wrong order
plugins: [tailwindcss(), ...csszyx()]

// ✅ Correct
plugins: [...csszyx(), tailwindcss()]
```

### Wrong: @source inline() in CSS
```css
/* ❌ Disables auto-scanning of sz output */
@source inline("p-4 bg-blue-500");

/* ✅ Just import tailwindcss — auto-scanning picks up csszyx output */
@import "tailwindcss";
```

For the lite reference: https://csszyx.com/llms.txt
For documentation: https://csszyx.com/guide/introduction
